FIELDS.NAME: Kitchen Haven Essentials
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Kitchen Haven Essentials, we specialize in retailing a wide assortment of high-quality kitchen and home accessories, including cookware, utensils, storage solutions, and decor items. Our store operates as a showroom where customers can explore our extensive product selection. All sales transactions are conducted on-site, ensuring a personalized shopping experience. We maintain a strict policy of not providing additional services, aligning with our commitment to safety and quality. Our operations emphasize effective inventory management and regular audits to ensure our products meet safety standards. Additionally, our staff is well-trained in customer service and product safety, allowing us to assist our customers with confidence and expertise. We also actively participate in industry trade shows to stay updated on the latest trends and product innovations.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Home Essentials Decor LLC, a specialty store offering home decorative items and accessories.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Losses incurred due to water damage from a leaking roof, affecting inventory and resulting in a total loss amount of $1,200. Incident was reported on 03/15/2023, and repairs were completed by 04/01/2023. Status: Resolved.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: 10:00 AM - 7:00 PM, Mon-Sat; 11:00 AM - 5:00 PM, Sun
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Heavy-Duty Steel Safe, Class A, UL Listed, Fire and Burglary Resistant
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Central Station Alarm System with 24-hour monitoring and security personnel presence during business hours.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Kitchen Haven Essentials does not store, treat, discharge, apply, dispose of, or transport hazardous materials as part of its operations, focusing instead on retailing kitchen and home accessories. Our operations adhere strictly to safety standards and do not involve hazardous materials handling.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – Kitchen Haven Essentials does not sponsor any athletic teams as part of our operations or community engagement efforts. Our focus remains solely on retailing kitchen and home accessories.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The company's Operations Manager, Emily Johnson, is responsible for checking these certificates to ensure compliance with insurance requirements.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – Kitchen Haven Essentials has not had any applicants indicted or convicted of any degree of the crime of fraud, bribery, arson, or any other arson-related crime in connection with this or any other property. We maintain a commitment to ethical business practices.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Kitchen Haven Essentials has not had any policies or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed in the prior 3 years. We maintain a consistent insurance history and adhere to all policy requirements.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Kitchen Haven Essentials does not lease employees to or from other employers, as we employ a dedicated staff for our retail operations.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Kitchen Haven Essentials carries Workers' Compensation insurance to comply with legal requirements and ensure the safety and well-being of our employees.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – Kitchen Haven Essentials also operates Home Essentials Decor LLC, a specialty store offering home decorative items and accessories.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Kitchen Haven Essentials does not have any other insurance policies with this company at this time. We maintain one active policy to cover our retail operations.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Kitchen Haven Essentials does not engage in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products; our focus is solely on retailing high-quality kitchen and home accessories. We ensure that all products are sourced from certified and reputable manufacturers.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Kitchen Haven Essentials does not rent or loan equipment to others, as our operations solely focus on retailing kitchen and home accessories without providing any rental services.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Kitchen Haven Essentials has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years, maintaining a stable financial position since its inception.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Kitchen Haven Essentials does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals, as our operations focus solely on retailing kitchen and home accessories without handling such materials. We strictly adhere to safety standards in our business practices.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Kitchen Haven Essentials does not have any catastrophe exposure, as our operations are located in a non-flood and non-seismic zone, and we maintain appropriate insurance coverage to mitigate potential risks.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Kitchen Haven Essentials has no past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. Our operations prioritize safety and ethical practices, and we maintain a strong commitment to compliance and employee training.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Kitchen Haven Essentials does not have any uncorrected fire code violations, ensuring compliance with all fire safety regulations and maintaining a safe environment for customers and employees.
